title: Model choices, alternatives, variants, and option-local behavior
acceptance_criteria:
- Selecting one option grants only that option's complete behavior.
- Sibling alternatives are never interpreted as cumulative by any consumer.
- Every option has a stable typed identifier and typed prerequisites (with B4).
- A flattened unconditional array of mutually exclusive behaviors fails a corpus-wide predicate.
- The language universe is open: campaign/GM-granted languages are representable rather than falsely closed.
